name: Deb Haaland

lean.basis: Progressive Democrat: former New Mexico Democratic Party chair, congresswoman (2019–2021), Biden's Interior secretary and governor-elect; supports the Green New Deal and Medicare for All.

source.title: File:Secretary Deb Haaland, official headshot.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Governor-elect of New Mexico (takes office January 1, 2027)
summary: Deb Haaland, a member of Laguna Pueblo, represented New Mexico in Congress from 2019 to 2021 and was Biden's Interior secretary from 2021 to 2025, the first Native American cabinet secretary. She won New Mexico's 2026 governor's race and will be the first Native American woman to govern a state. New Mexico is among the first states in the 2028 Democratic calendar, and she says she wants a say in candidates' platforms.
